'''Tisocco''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Reussi]] who worked for [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]]. In [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]] he was part of a mission led by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Bren Derlin/Legends|Bren Derlin]] to stop the illegal organ donation trade being perpetuated on the Reussi by [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Torel Vorne]] and the [[Reuss Corporation]]. Acting in a bodyguard capacity, he drove the team's [[speedervan]] and posed as a sound technician to [[Colonial News Nets]] reporter and NRI [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Fionna Flannis]], stunning one of Vorne's [[Defel/Legends|Defel]] henchmen who tried to silence her line of questioning about Vorne's activities during a widely publicized pre-fight interview with [[Shockboxing/Legends|shockboxer]] [[Lobar Aybock]].

Later, Tisocco was shot in the shoulder by the same Defel, sent by Vorne to assassinate fellow agent and [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Dansra Beezer]] in the course of the mission. Tisocco recovered, but the Defel did not survive the encounter.
